## Report domains

ROS reports cover ALL, LL, PS, PL, and GN. Each gear report includes its gear, the shared schemas, and reference tables.

```{r domains}
# Load the domain definitions.
library(ros.db.atlas)
# Inspect which ROS schemas belong to each domain.
ROS_SCHEMAS
```

## Generate one domain

Use the tracked metadata snapshot and run this command from the repository root.

```{r render-ll, eval=FALSE}
# Render the longline report and its dependency graph.
report_file <- ros_db_metadata_generate_report(domain = "LL")
# Display the rendered report path.
report_file
```

The renderer uses `dependencies.csv` when present to retain the connected reference tables.

## Render all domains and navigation

```{r render-all, eval=FALSE}
# Render all five domains in a dated directory and update the indexes.
ros_generate_documentation(date = "2026-09-29")
```

The report directory is `output/model/4.0.0/2026-09-29/`. Rendering the same date replaces its reports.

The graphs share `graph-assets/`. Keep that directory with the HTML files when moving a dated report directory.

See [Getting started](atlas.html) for editing the snapshot before regeneration.
